note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the Merkava main battle tank. The registry marks primary_held false. It publishes the mass, the length with and without the gun barrel, the width excluding skirts, the height to the turret roof, the ground clearance, the engine rating, the transmission, the road and cross-country speeds and the range. The infobox figures are those of the current Mark, so the entry names the Mk 4.

operating_weight_kg.state: mass published as 65 t; the tonne taken as 1,000 kg

length_mm.locator: Infobox, length row, with gun barrel entry
length_mm.state: length published as 9.04 m including the gun barrel; the same row publishes 7.60 m excluding the gun barrel

width_mm.state: width published as 3.72 m excluding the skirts

height_mm.state: height published as 2.66 m to the turret roof

ground_clearance_mm.state: ground clearance published as 0.45 m; the metre figure converted to mm

net_power_kw.state: engine published as an MTU 12V883 turbocharged diesel of 1,119 kW, with no net basis stated

engine_model.state: engine published as an MTU 12V883 turbocharged diesel

max_speed_kmh.locator: Infobox, speed row, on road entry
max_speed_kmh.state: maximum road speed published as 64 km/h; the off-road speed is published as 55 km/h
